text: 中国央行今日开展600亿元人民币7天期逆回购操作，利率1.40% （上次为1.40%）。今日20亿元逆回购到期。中国央行公开市场本周净回笼260亿元。
text_en: The People's Bank of China today conducted 60 billion yuan of 7-day reverse repos at an interest rate of 1.40% (previous: 1.40%). Today 2 billion yuan of reverse repos matured. The PBOC's open market operations saw a net withdrawal of 26 billion yuan this week.
